rows.name: LEMAN & OWER LT.-V.
rows.character: Upper rev. lt. 1 min., lower fixed light
rows.description: In 16 fathoms between the Sands; lts. at unequal heights; two red balls. Gong; warning gun

rows.name: CROMER
rows.description: Near the cliff; a white tower, 59 ft. high

rows.name: Hunstanton
rows.description: The light is red, over the Roaring Middle Sand, from W.N.W. to N.W. by W.

rows.name: Lynn Well Lightvessel
rows.description: In 17½ fathoms, off the hook of the Long Sand. Gong; warning gun

rows.name: Lynn Channel Lt.-Vessel
rows.description: Moored in 3½ fms., at N.E. end of Wisbeach Bar Flat, 8½ miles above Lynn Well lt.-ves. Gong. Warning Guu.

rows.name: Lynn
rows.description: Leading lights; in one, S. ¾ E., 555 ft. apart.

rows.name: Boston
rows.description: Two bright fixed leading lights at Hob Hole.

rows.name: Inner Dowsing Lt.-ves.
rows.description: In 10 fathoms, near N.E. end of shoal. Two globes vertically. Gong. Warning-gun

rows.name: DUDGEON LIGHT-VES.
rows.description: In 9 fathoms, near South side of shoal. Gong. Warning-gun

rows.name: OUTER DOWSING LT.-V.
rows.description: In 9 fms., on W. side of shoal. Half ball over other ball. Fog-horn, 5 secs. every 2 min. Warning-gun

rows.name: Spurn Lightvessel
rows.description: In 9½ fms., off the point. Warning-gun. Fog-horn, 2 blasts every 2 min. Warning-gun

rows.name: SPURN POINT
rows.description: High lt.-ho. red; low lt.-ho. white. In one, N.W. ½ N., 464 ft. apart. High lt. red betw., Sandhaile and Grimsby Pier, or from S.E. by S. to N.W. by W. ¾ W.

rows.name: Bull Sand Lightvessel
rows.description: One bright fixed light off Spurn Pt. Fog-bell

rows.name: Grimsby
rows.character: Three fixed red lts. Two green lights
rows.description: Red lt. on each pier-head of outer basin, and red lt. on outer pier, E. side of entr. to Fish Dock; green lt. shown at E. or W. entr. to Fish Dock when gate is open

rows.name: Middle Sand Light-ves.
rows.description: Red light near a wreck

rows.name: Stallingborough Ferry
rows.description: One bright fixed light to E.N.E.

rows.name: Killingholme
rows.description: Lights in one, N.W., lead up the river; and when S. by W. lead down

rows.name: Thorngumbald Clough
rows.description: Two fixed leading lights

rows.name: Salt End
rows.description: Two fixed leading lights

rows.name: Withernsea
rows.description: Red light at end of pier

rows.name: Bridlington
rows.description: On the North pier-head while 9 ft. water

rows.name: FLAMBORO' HEAD
rows.character: One revolv. lt. ½ min., br. br. and red alternately
rows.description: A white tower, 87 ft. high; bearing N.N.E., clears N. end of Smithic. A new lens apparatus, established June 22, 1872, showing br. br. & red flashes, of equal intensity, every ½ minute. In fogs, rockets fired ev. 10 min., to explode at an elevation of 600 or 700 ft.

rows.name: Scarborough Tide Light
rows.description: While 10 ft. water; on Vincent Pier; bright toward harbour. A ball by day

rows.name: HIGH WHITBY
rows.description: In one, S. by E. ¾ E. (258 yards apart). A red lt. from N. tower over the Scar Rock
